propositions: Cross-subtree blocking links are silently escalated to nearest common ancestor children; caller receives no indication that different endpoints were recorded than requested
Redirect record is emitted only to stdout via _emit_redirect and never returned, making it invisible to library and MCP callers while visible only to CLI
Five layers in the propagation chain from add_dependency through rebar.link to link_tickets currently drop or fail to return the redirect record value
The quiet=True context manager suppresses both the redirect record and warning output, protecting MCP-over-stdio protocol integrity but preventing callers from receiving escalation information
MCP link_tickets tool returns literal 'ok' string regardless of whether endpoints were escalated, leaving agents unaware of endpoint substitution
